scope: Add written Corollary 5.3 ruling out full-stabilizer equivariance of a proper 15-coloring with the induced clique-label action; replace the earlier open-question suggestion.
proof: Swapping coordinates 1 and 2 is orthogonal and fixes T pointwise, hence all 15 clique color labels. It exchanges the adjacent lines span(e1), span(e2). Equivariance would give equal colors to adjacent vertices.

limits: This is a written proof and coordinate replay, not a Lean theorem. It concerns the full orthogonal stabilizer and the 15 labels fixed by the clique. Structural rules with auxiliary choices or smaller symmetry groups are not excluded. Structural 15-coloring and n7 remain open.
